items.title: Rockstar's own team doubted GTA VI's launch day would ever come
items.summary: Polygon reports co-studio head Rob Nelson told GamesRadar that after 13 years of development, many on Rockstar's senior team felt the Nov. 19 launch might never actually arrive — he called finally shipping GTA VI surreal and a relief, with the team still in disbelief until players started talking about and playing it.

items.title: Did GTA VI live up to 13 years of hype? Polygon weighs the backlash
items.summary: Polygon argues GTA VI did live up to its hype, pointing to a 99 Metacritic score and a true monoculture launch — and reading even the review bombing that dragged its user score to 5.7 as proof: the loud backlash, rather than indifference, shows the game landed exactly as big as the 13-year wait promised.

items.title: A major GTA VI spoiler is spreading online — here's how to dodge it
items.summary: TheGamer warns that a late-game reveal is being spammed across TikTok comments, subreddits and social replies while about half of players are still in the early chapters, and advises muting keywords and avoiding comment sections until you've finished the story. (The linked article names the spoiler.)

items.title: GTA VI's headphones were first planned for Vice City back in 2002
items.summary: TweakTown reports former Rockstar tech lead Obbe Vermeij says a portable radio feature was planned for GTA: Vice City in 2002 — the team even made a pickup icon for it — but it was cut for a technical reason he no longer recalls; GTA VI finally ships the idea, letting players keep listening to radio and podcasts on foot through earbuds after stepping out of a car, though neither version lets you pick individual tracks.

items.title: Guide: complete the brainwashing Easter egg and the Russo bunkers
items.summary: Polygon walks through the long 'Kill the President' Easter egg: start with José Bermúdez by the Joe Russo monument in Downtown Vice City, open the Sharktooth Island presidential bunker with code 010317 and its safe with 2975 to find Russo's 1922 pistol, then the Grassrivers bunker hatch with 085355, and work through the IAA black site's time-loop sequence (door code 090607) to finish with the Brainwasher 1922 pistol and the 'Brainwashed' tattoo design. (Spoilers.)

items.title: GTA VI passes 50 million copies in its first week, estimates say
items.summary: Polygon reports Alinea Analytics estimates GTA VI sold 53 million copies in the week after its Nov. 19 release, worth about $4.7 billion — against GTA V's 29 million copies in its entire first month — with more than 75% of copies sold on PS5, nearly 7 million players already past 50 hours in the game, and around 250,000 past 100 hours.

items.title: Guide: every story choice in GTA VI and what each one does
items.summary: GameRant catalogues all 28 main-story choices across GTA VI's five chapters and what each one changes: sparing Arnold pays out $10,000 from Brian in Chapter 4, taking the pure product in Dealer's Choice avoids a shootout, and saving Nicole in The Cartel Heist takes a $10 million vault haul — while plenty of smaller picks, like Lucia's dress or whether to shake Mattia's hand, change nothing at all. (Spoilers.)

items.title: Rockstar explains why GTA VI's chainsaws and katanas aren't usable weapons
items.summary: TheGamer reports Rockstar producer Rob Nelson told VGC that hyper-violent weapons from older GTA games, like the chainsaw and the katana, were left unusable in GTA VI because at this level of realism they would have been too much for Jason and Lucia — not a resource limit, but a fit-for-the-characters call; chainsaws still appear around Leonida as decoration only, while smaller omissions such as darts and bowling were cut as not worth the development time.

items.title: In GTA VI, Jason and Lucia never get to sit down for a proper meal
items.summary: Kotaku notes that for all GTA VI's food detail — bites visibly disappearing from apples and empanadas, drink levels dropping as the pair sip — Jason and Lucia only ever eat handheld takeout on the go: there is no cooking and no sit-down restaurant meal anywhere in the game, every would-be dining room is locked, and the piece reads that absence as deliberate, a sign the couple never get to slow down or feel safe.

items.title: Rockstar's UK staff vote 75% against union recognition
items.summary: Polygon reports Rockstar's UK workforce voted 75% to 25% against a formal recognition deal with the IWGB Game Workers Union, on 93.2% turnout with 1,544 staff across the Edinburgh, Leeds, Lincoln, Dundee and London offices taking part — so management will not be required to meet or negotiate with the union, though staff can still organize and the IWGB says it will keep fighting; the two-week ballot ran through GTA VI's launch week alongside the still-pending tribunal over 31 workers fired in 2025.

items.title: GTA VI tops Japan's chart and gives PS5 a rare weekly win over Switch 2
items.summary: Push Square reports Famitsu's chart for the week ending Nov. 22 puts GTA VI at No. 1 in Japan with 200,759 boxed PS5 copies — below GTA V's 304,752 opening there in 2013, with the code-in-a-box release and the shift to digital noted — and the launch pushed PS5 hardware to 41,472 units for the week, ahead of Switch 2's 36,817 for a rare weekly win on Nintendo's home turf.

items.title: GTA VI lifts UK games retail 99% to £142m in launch week
items.summary: MCV reports NielsenIQ data showing UK games retail revenue reached £142m in GTA VI's launch week, up 99% week on week: boxed software hit £43m, up 409% and the biggest week for physical games since Christmas 2018, with GTA VI alone accounting for £32m — about 74% of physical software revenue, 88% of it on launch day — while console hardware sales rose 38% and accessories brought in £21m, up 123%.

items.title: Rockstar's custom GTA VI PS5 Pro consoles are giveaway-only — just 100 exist
items.summary: TweakTown reports Rockstar is giving away, not selling, at least 100 custom GTA VI PS5 Pro consoles — dark gray-and-black with etched palm trees, the GTA VI logo and neon teal-to-magenta accents, each carrying a unique serial number — first to Miami Heat players before launch and now to streamers and influencers such as Davy Jones, while the matching black and white limited-edition DualSense controllers are sold at retail for $84.99.

items.title: Guide: find all four Peewees billboards and claim the grand prize
items.summary: Polygon lists all four Peewees billboards — one each in Vice-Dale, Mariana County, Lummox County and Leonard County — to scan with the WAiNK app for the Mr. Enigma scavenger hunt: the letters hidden in the clue photos unscramble to Belville, where the Peewees manager hands over a hat, a shirt and free Peewees food.

items.title: Guide: find all 12 Key Lento standout vehicles
items.summary: Polygon maps all 12 standout vehicles in Key Lento — part of 280 across Leonida — to scan with the WAiNK app, from the Spiderweb Coquette in a house-party garage (keypad code 092319) and the Christmas-decorated Rudolph Tao boat to the pizza-topped Cousin Carlo's Akane, noting some spawns are not permanent so a spot may need a repeat visit.
